capabilities: connect to a Matter account via QR code
sync Matter highlights and notes into the vault
run background syncing after initial setup
extras: Support is handled through the Matter app itself (email or in-app feedback) and the Obsidian Discord; README mentions a demo video but content is not shown in text.
problem: Highlights and notes saved in the Matter reading app have no built-in way to flow into an Obsidian vault.
summary: Plugin that syncs Matter app highlights and notes into the vault, connecting via QR code and syncing in the background.
